religions.name: The Old Faith (Iman Lama)
religions.worldview: Emphasizes tradition, continuity, and community covenant.
central_beliefs: Salvation through faith and good works.
religions.architecture: Stone churches with spires, raised pulpit, communion table

religions.name: The New Light (Cahaya Baru)
religions.worldview: Emphasizes personal conversion, Scripture authority, egalitarianism.
religions.architecture: Plain meeting houses, no stained glass, simple pulpit

religions.name: Folk Religion
religions.worldview: Mix of Christian morality, local superstitions, folk customs.
